evidence: ALD was performed in a stainless steel fluidized bed reactor under vacuum conditions between 100 and 3000 mtorr (King et al. 2007). A cycle of ALD consisted of a platinum precursor dose for 40 min, a nitrogen purge for 70 min, a second precursor dose (oxygen or hydrogen) for 90 min, and a nitrogen purge for 180 min; one cycle duration was 380 min (6.33 h).
